source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: Queries in util/query.scala go through the high-level API hi/connection.scala, which builds free programs. The Transactor runs them with kleisliinterpreter.scala, with the hikari, postgres and otel4s modules adding pooling, types and tracing.
